evidence: Carries the Validation label, modifies src/consensus/validation.h and src/validation.cpp, and enforces invariants on ValidationState.
rationale: Enforces via runtime Assumes that invalid ValidationState instances have an explicit result enum and non-empty reject reason, retiring an ambiguous failure state introduced in PR #31981. This prevents silent omission of failure details in callers like TestBlockValidity, though it does not fix a consensus critical bug or vulnerability.
